name: container_absent_otel
title: Container disappeared
description: A container that was running 10 minutes ago is no longer running. It stopped, crashed without a restart policy, or was removed. Deploys that replace containers under new names also trigger this alert. Containers named k8s_* are left out: Kubernetes gives a restarted container a new name suffix, so they would fire on every restart; use the Kubernetes alerts for them.

query_condition.promql: count by (container_name) (container_memory_usage_total{container_name!~"k8s_.*"} offset 10m) unless count by (container_name) (container_memory_usage_total{container_name!~"k8s_.*"})
